    About B2Spin
    We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.

    AI-Driven Engineering Culture
    We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software — not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.
    AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essential—AI amplifies our engineers, it doesn’t replace responsibility for technical decisions.

    The Role
    You’ll be building and maintaining mission-critical payment systems that handle massive scale and directly impact millions of users worldwide.

    What you will be doing
    • Write well-designed, testable and scalable code in a timely manner
    • Take part in the full development cycle from sprint planning to release cycles
    • Ensure smooth development and cooperation between dev teams and product owners
    • Build and maintain high-load systems that handle massive scale
    • Troubleshoot production issues using metrics, alerts, monitoring and profiling
    • Contribute to seamless scaling and automation initiatives

    What we are looking for
    • Strong Java Core expertise (Java 8+) with proven track record in enterprise environments
    • Deep expertise in multithreading and high-load systems architecture
    • Solid SQL knowledge and database optimization skills
    • Strong experience with Docker and containerization ecosystem
    • Excellent troubleshooting skills with production monitoring tools
    • Strong English communication skills in speaking and writing

    Bonus points for: Experience with Clickhouse, GCP, Kafka ecosystem, ElasticSearch, Ebean, Protobuf, InfluxDB/Grafana, Google Services integration, SPA and modern mobile/web technologies, or fintech experience.

    Main technologies: Java, Spring, Spring Boot, Ebean-ORM, Quartz, Maven, Resteasy, Flyway, PostgreSQL 15, HTTP/Websockets, Netty, K8S/Docker, GCP, Jenkins, ELK, Grafana

    Why you will love it
    You’ll be at the forefront of AI-driven engineering in a fast-scaling environment where your code directly impacts millions of users. Work with cutting-edge technology (latest Java, Spring Boot, GCP, Kubernetes) while enjoying full remote flexibility, generous leave, and real opportunities for growth. Join a team that treats AI as a core engineering tool—not an experiment—and where engineering excellence, speed, and meaningful impact are part of everyday work.

    Performa is an international HR agency connecting top talent with ambitious companies across iGaming, IT, and Marketing. We help businesses build strong teams and professionals find opportunities where their expertise can make a real impact.
     

    For our client, we are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager (iGaming) to join a new online crypto casino project in Dubai, launched as a spin-off from a large international online casino brand.

    This is an early-stage opportunity for a hands-on marketing professional who wants to take an active role in building and developing the marketing function of a growing iGaming product. You will work across the full marketing cycle — from player acquisition, affiliates, CRM and retention to promotions, content, social and community channels, campaign analytics and reporting — while coordinating internal teams, agencies, and external partners.
     

    The role offers broad exposure across casino and sportsbook marketing, the opportunity to directly influence campaign execution and player growth, and room to develop into a channel lead role as the business scales.

         Responsibilities
     

         Marketing Planning and Campaign Delivery
     

    • Maintain the integrated marketing calendar and execute approved plans across casino, sportsbook, target GEOs and player-lifecycle stages.
    • Translate commercial objectives into clear briefs, timelines, owners, assets, landing pages, tracking requirements, approvals and post-campaign reviews.
    • Coordinate marketing readiness for brand, market, product, game and promotion launches with Casino/Sportsbook, CRM, Operations, Risk, Legal & Compliance and IT Department.
    • Manage day-to-day delivery by agencies, freelancers and marketing vendors, tracking deliverables, costs and required documentation.
       

         Acquisition, Affiliates and Partnerships
     

    • Support player acquisition across affiliates, paid media, SEO/content, influencers and streamers, social and community channels and relevant crypto-native networks.
    • Source, onboard and coordinate affiliates, creators and media partners, including briefs, approved commercial terms, tracking links, promo codes, creatives and launch support.
    • Monitor channel, campaign and partner performance; identify opportunities to scale, optimise or stop activity based on player quality and unit economics.
    • Work with Risk to identify suspicious, incentivised or low-quality traffic and with Legal & Compliance to enforce brand, advertising and responsible-gambling requirements.

      CRM, Promotions and Player Lifecycle
       
    • Coordinate segmented campaigns and automated journeys across onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation and loyalty using email, push, SMS and onsite/in-app channels.
    • Maintain the casino and sportsbook promotion calendar, coordinating welcome offers, reloads, cashback, free spins, tournaments, major events and reactivation campaigns.
    • Ensure offers, eligibility rules, limits, terms and conditions, consent and suppression rules receive all required commercial, Risk and Legal & Compliance approvals before launch.
    • Run structured A/B tests across audiences, offers, messages, creatives, channels, timing and landing pages, and apply learnings to future campaigns.

      Analytics, Governance and Cross-functional Improvement
       
    • Produce concise weekly and monthly reporting covering FTDs, conversion, CPA/CAC, ROAS, NGR contribution, LTV, retention, bonus cost, traffic quality and channel profitability.
    • Track marketing spend against approved budgets, validate vendor and partner performance and reconcile cost reporting with Finance; escalate variances promptly.
    • Maintain auditable campaign approvals and ensure no activity launches without required GEO, advertising, data-privacy, responsible-gambling and promotional clearances.
    • Work with Payments, Operations and Customer Support to identify and reduce friction across registration, deposit, gameplay, promotion and retention journeys.

      Brand, Content and Community
       
    • Apply the approved brand positioning, tone of voice and visual standards consistently across player touchpoints.
    • Coordinate content and creative production for websites, landing pages, social media, communities, CRM, affiliate materials and promotional placements, including localization and quality assurance. 
    • Support day-to-day community presence and campaign activation across relevant platforms and streaming channels. 
    • Monitor competitors, market trends, player sentiment and cultural nuances across priority GEOs and convert observations into actionable campaign recommendations.

      Requirements
       
    • 5+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience, including practical experience in iGaming, online casino, sportsbook or betting.
    • Demonstrated delivery across at least two core channels - performance acquisition, affiliates, CRM/retention, content/SEO, social/community or influencer marketing - with working knowledge of the others.
    • Strong understanding of the iGaming player funnel, including registration, FTD, deposits, conversion, retention, reactivation, bonuses and player value.
    • Working knowledge of affiliate commercial models (CPA, RevShare and Hybrid), tracking links, postbacks, promo codes and traffic-quality considerations.
    • Experience coordinating campaign briefs, creative production, localisation, landing pages, approvals, launch QA and external partners. 
    • Data-driven approach and confidence working with GA4 or comparable analytics, dashboards, attribution data and marketing unit economics. 
    • Good understanding of responsible-gambling, advertising, promotional and data-privacy controls applicable to player marketing.
    • Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills, attention to detail and fluent written and spoken English.

      Preferred Qualifications
       
    • Experience with a crypto casino or sportsbook.
    • Familiarity with CRM, affiliate, CMS, SEO, tag-management and BI tools relevant to iGaming.
    • Experience supporting new-brand or multi-GEO launches in regulated or high-risk digital environments.
       

         We Offer
     

    • On-site work in Dubai, UAE.
    • Relocation support where needed.
    • A hands-on role supporting the full marketing function of an early-stage online crypto casino and sportsbook, with broad channel exposure, room to grow into a channel lead role.
    • A competitive compensation package (discussed individually).

    WEB DEVELOPER

    Role Overview

    We are looking for a WordPress Web Developer who can take a website task from concept through implementation, testing, and live deployment.

    You will work closely with our design, content, SEO, Growth, and project management teams to build, update, optimize, and troubleshoot WordPress websites for our dental marketing clients.

    The ideal candidate is a hands-on developer who can work independently within WordPress, translate designs and requirements into polished web experiences, solve technical problems, and consistently deliver high-quality work across multiple client websites.

     

    What You'll Do

    WordPress Development & Implementation

    • Build, update, and customize WordPress websites from initial requirements through live deployment.
    • Implement new pages, content, layouts, functionality, and design changes based on approved designs and client specifications.
    • Customize WordPress themes, plugins, templates, and modules as needed.
    • Work independently within WordPress to complete development tasks without requiring step-by-step technical direction.
    • Use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress functionality to implement website changes.
    • Work with WordPress page builders, particularly Elementor and/or Divi.
    • Translate designs from Figma and Photoshop into responsive, functional web pages.
    • Develop and publish blog content and other website content.

    Responsive Design & Quality Assurance

    • Ensure websites are responsive and function correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
    • Perform cross-browser testing and troubleshoot compatibility issues.
    • Test functionality, layouts, links, forms, and other website components before deployment.
    • Identify and resolve bugs, errors, and website performance issues.
    • Follow established development standards, SOPs, and quality-control processes.

    Website Performance & SEO

    • Implement website updates with consideration for SEO, performance, accessibility, and user experience.
    • Apply basic SEO principles to page structure, content implementation, metadata, links, images, and other on-page elements.
    • Work with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and WordPress performance/optimization plugins.
    • Help improve website performance and technical quality based on established client goals and internal standards.

    Collaboration & Communication

    • Work closely with designers, content specialists, SEO specialists, Growth team members, and project managers.
    • Communicate clearly about project requirements, technical limitations, progress, and issues.
    • Ask appropriate questions when requirements are unclear and proactively identify potential problems.
    • Manage multiple client projects and prioritize tasks according to deadlines and business requirements.
    • Document development processes and significant code or configuration changes.
    • Collaborate with other developers to improve reusable components, templates, workflows, and development standards.

    Continuous Improvement

    • Help maintain and expand our library of reusable WordPress templates, components, and custom modules.
    • Contribute ideas for improving development efficiency, website quality, and internal processes.
    • Stay current with WordPress, web development, responsive design, performance, accessibility, and security best practices.
    • Provide basic guidance or training to clients and internal team members when needed.

     

    Required Qualifications

    These are the core requirements for the role:

    WordPress Development

    • Demonstrated experience building and deploying WordPress websites independently.
    • Experience with WordPress theme and plugin customization.
    • Ability to take a website task from requirements/design through implementation, QA, and live deployment.
    • Demonstrated experience with at least one major WordPress page builder, preferably Elementor and/or Divi.

    Front-End Development

    • Strong working knowledge of:
      • HTML5
      • CSS3
      • JavaScript
    • Working knowledge of PHP, particularly as it relates to WordPress customization and troubleshooting.
    • Understanding of responsive web development and mobile-first considerations.

    Quality Assurance

    • Experience testing websites across browsers and devices.
    • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify and resolve visual and functional issues.
    • Understanding of website performance and basic accessibility standards.

    Communication

    • B2+ English proficiency, both written and spoken.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
    • Ability to work effectively with an international, distributed team.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in an asynchronous environment.

     

    Nice-to-Have Qualifications

    These skills are valuable but not required:

    • Experience with LESS or another CSS preprocessor such as Sass.
    • Experience with additional WordPress builders such as:
      • WPBakery
      • DMS
      • Cornerstone
    • Experience with GoHighLevel.
    • Ability to make design decisions and improve the visual appearance of websites without a dedicated designer.

    About us

    UAPP.AI is a product company. We build AI-powered mobile applications used by over 10 million people. The full product cycle stays in-house — from the idea to scale and monetization. Decisions are fast and data-driven, without bureaucracy.
     

    The Role

    We run a subscription product across mobile and web. Payments go direct, through our own provider stack — Stripe, Unlimit, Payable, Traspay, SolidGate, Checkout.com, ADN, Apple.

    We are looking for a Head of Payments to strengthen the payments direction: onboarding new providers and products, domain compliance, fees, reconciliation and approval rate on rebills.

    The role is hands-on: you work alongside the team, not only assign tasks.
     

    What you will do

    • Provider onboarding: new PSPs, plus new products with providers we already work with — applications via agents, merchant ID registration, entities
    • Domain compliance: preparing the websites we submit for onboarding to meet provider requirements — knowing what has to be stated, how and where (terms, refund and subscription cancellation policy, pricing, product description, contacts, support) and keeping it current after underwriting
    • Recurring and rebills: retry logic, soft/hard declines, payment-method update flows, reducing involuntary churn
    • Approval rate: audit by GEO, provider and card scheme, routing and cascading priorities
    • Commercial terms: negotiating fees and rolling reserves, auditing commissions to see where the money leaks
    • Reconciliation and reporting: settlement reconciliation, payment reporting, cost transparency per product and provider
    • Analytics: your own dashboards on payment metrics, built with AI tools
       

    What we expect

    • 4+ years in payments, at least 2 at Head / Lead level
    • A portfolio of several PSPs: Stripe, SolidGate, Checkout.com, Unlimit and similar
    • Merchant onboarding: applications, merchant IDs, underwriting
    • Understanding of provider compliance requirements for websites: what has to be stated and where
    • Recurring payments: rebills, decline handling, churn caused by failed payments
    • Approval-rate and fee optimization — with numbers behind it
    • Willingness to work hands-on and use AI tools daily
    • English B2+
       

    Nice to have

    • Mobile subscriptions, IAP, web-to-app funnels
    • Negotiating enterprise terms with Tier-1 providers
       

    What we offer

    • Fully remote, full-time
    • A working stack and a team already running the direction — you join a live process
    • Fast decisions without long approval chains
    • A product with 10M+ users and a growing subscription business — the result of your work shows on the revenue chart
    • Competitive USD-pegged compensation, reviewed on results
       

    Hiring process

    1. Intro call with the recruiter
    2. Call with the CEO
    3. Offer

    Our Mission and Vision

     

    At Solidgate, our mission is clear: to empower outstanding entrepreneurs to build exceptional internet companies. We exist to fuel the builders — the ones shaping the digital economy — with the financial infrastructure they deserve. To achieve that, we're on a bold path: to become the #1 payments orchestration platform in the world.

    We believe the future of payments is shaped by people who think big, take ownership, and bring curiosity and drive to everything they do. That's exactly the kind of teammates we want on board.

     

    We're building the #1 payment orchestrator in the world — and the names behind us prove it. Clients include Bolt, Ajax, Nova Post, MEGOGO. Trusted by giants like J.P. Morgan. Ranked #2 in the "Employer of the Year 2026" award by Forbes Ukraine.

     

    About the Role and the Team

    Our Platform stream acts as a backbone for product teams, handling the complexities of infrastructure, efficient technical solutions, and development frameworks. This allows product teams to concentrate on what they do best: developing and refining product features and experiences.

    ⚡ This role is for a builder. You'll take ownership of teams inside our Platform stream — the merchant-facing side of the shared services every other product team and merchant at Solidgate runs on.

    Your mentor — Mykola Stasiuk, Senior Product Manager on the Platform stream, who leads the other two, data-oriented teams.

     

    What You Will Own

    You'll shape and evolve these core components:

    • Auth — authentication, authorization, access management across all admin panels
    • Notification system — how merchants and internal teams get informed, reliably
    • Audit and Approval Manager — logging and approval workflows that hold up under scrutiny
    • File Management — file upload, export, and report generation
    • Bulk operations and MCP
    • UI Kit — the shared component library other teams build their interfaces on

     

    Why This Is Exciting

    • Real leverage — one good decision here moves dozens of teams and every merchant at once, not just your own backlog
    • Strong technical culture — you'll work with engineers who think about architecture, not ticket counts
    • Fast feedback — ship something, and you'll see how it performs within days, not quarters
    • Since the domain is technical, you're working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers constantly — meaning you build technical depth in a fraction of the time other PMs take
    • You shape it, not inherit it — parts of this domain are still being formed, so you decide how it works

     

    You'll be great at this if:

    • you have 2+ years in a B2B product — what matters isn't your title, but your background: a technical foundation and real cases where you've built new solutions and features, and shaped the direction of the product
    • you're comfortable enough with APIs and CI/CD that you don't need an engineer to explain the basics
    • you bring curiosity, drive, and strong cognitive skills to everything you do
    • you're a structured thinker who brings order to ambiguous, cross-team requests
    • you find common ground with strong-opinioned engineers without losing your own point of view

     

    Why Join Solidgate?

    High-impact role. You're not inheriting a perfect system — you're shaping one.
    Great product. We've built a fintech powerhouse that scales fast. Solidgate isn't just an orchestration player — it's the financial infrastructure for modern internet businesses. From subscriptions to chargeback management, fraud prevention, and indirect tax — we've got it covered.
    Growth opportunity. Solidgate is scaling rapidly — this role will be a career-defining move.
    Top-tier tech team. Work alongside a proven, results-driven engineering team that delivers.

     

    Tomorrow's fintech needs your mindset. Come build it with us.

     

    🫂 Know top talent? We're always on the lookout. Recommend someone for our role, and if they get hired, there's a bonus waiting for you — simple as that.
